1.consolidated_definition: transp. Furgón de cola. La desaparición del ferrocarril en Puerto Rico puede explicar la paulatina retirada de este anglicismo en el país. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Locomotora GP 38 de Life Like incluye un caboose. Verdaderamente rápida, con potente luz, completamente nueva
1.en_consolidated_definition: Caboose. A type of freight car. The disappearance of the railroad in Puerto Rico may explain the gradual withdrawal of this anglicism from the country. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. The Life Like locomotive GP 38 includes a caboose. Truly fast, with powerful light, completely new
